summary: Assess dividend capacity, compare investments and prepare board recommendations using FCFE, NPV and ROIC. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Dividend policy and capital allocation analysis connects cash available for distribution with competing investment needs. For finance managers, treasury professionals and corporate planners, the course develops practical analysis for dividend and funding recommendations. You will assess free cash flow and liquidity, compare projects using NPV, IRR and ROIC, and prepare a board memo that makes assumptions and sensitivities clear.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who prepare or review corporate dividend recommendations, investment cases and funding plans. It is designed for roles that connect company cash, shareholder distributions and competing capital requests.
modules: Liquidity, Debt Service and Currency Risk
prerequisites: Working knowledge of company financial statements, cash-flow concepts and basic corporate finance is expected. No coding or programming is required. Advanced valuation and payout-smoothing concepts receive conceptual coverage; spreadsheet analysis is practised at an operational level.
topics: Project finance, appraisal & public investment management
